import argparse
import sys


def transform(text, upper=False, reverse=False):
    if upper:
        text = text.upper()
    if reverse:
        text = text[::-1]
    return text


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Join TEXT arguments and transform the result."
    )
    parser.add_argument("--upper", action="store_true", help="uppercase the result")
    parser.add_argument("--reverse", action="store_true", help="reverse the result")
    parser.add_argument(
        "text",
        nargs="*",
        metavar="TEXT",
        help="text arguments, joined with single spaces",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    if not args.text:
        parser.error("at least one TEXT argument is required")

    joined = " ".join(args.text)
    result = transform(joined, upper=args.upper, reverse=args.reverse)
    print(result)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
